note: Authored by agent per design_shortcuts_v1.md. Every shortcut is DIRECT: page expands steps client-side (resolve objects) and sends via existing ntfy transport. No LLM at tap time. Convention (2026-08-11): play shortcuts set volume to 18 before playing, unless the shortcut specifies otherwise. v17 (2026-10-03, p3.46): tiles with target:"selection" have no house/rooms — they play on the chips selected in the current house (resolve.selection → rooms = selectedRooms[house], room = rooms[0]; play_uri never regroups). inherit_volume:false skips the D10 default-volume injection (B1: leave levels as they are). v19 (2026-10-14): defaults.volume_by_room gains “Sara’s Office” = 12 (new Cap Hill speaker, quiet room; name carries a curly apostrophe U+2019 exactly as Sonos reports it).

shortcuts.label: KEXP → Deck + Sauna
shortcuts.note: KEXP (TuneIn stream) → Main Lower Deck + Sauna Porch (added 2026-10-02, Andrew). URI = the TuneIn-resolved KEXP 160k AAC stream exactly as Sonos reports it in our own KEXP radio sessions (ids 13351/23928/24280, Jun–Aug 2026); ingest detects 'kexp' in the URI → sonos_kexp radio session → KEXP enrichment, same path as the KCRW tiles. Same two-step shape as kcrw-e24-caphill-main: sync_rooms pins topology to exactly the two outdoor rooms (Lower Deck coordinator, 6s settle), then play_uri. play_uri carries BOTH rooms in `rooms` (service plays on rooms[0]'s live coordinator; the page's D10 tap-time inheritance then sets BOTH rooms to their live defaults — Lower Deck 39, Sauna Porch 35 — and D9 chips follow both). No baked volumes (D11).

shortcuts.label: Sigur Sauna
shortcuts.note: Sigur Rós Radio (Spotify artist radio) → Sauna Porch (added 2026-11-22, Andrew; his title "Sigur Sauna"). URI = the Spotify artist-radio container he already plays by hand on this speaker (history ids 34337-34340 on 2026-11-10, 166028 on 2026-11-16: spotify:artistRadio:6UUrUCIZtQeOf8tC0WuzRy, sid=12, sn=1); artist id verified against Spotify 2026-11-22. The play_uri step carries an explicit DIDL `meta` with the Spotify service token (SA_RINCON3079 = sid 12) and the #artistRadio class - without it SoCo sends TuneIn metadata and Sonos cannot open a Spotify station. Probe T1 2026-11-22T22:04:48Z on the test room (Second Bedroom, vol 12, agent_test) started in ~5 s with this exact uri+meta. Bach-pattern ungroup-first: sync_rooms pins topology to Sauna Porch alone (structure sauna; explicit rooms kept for the p3.56 page runner), then play_uri. No baked volume: Sauna Porch inherits its live default at tap time (D10/D11, currently 35). It is radio: Spotify picks the tracks and no queue is built.

defaults.note: Default play volume per room. Used by play shortcuts without explicit volume, by play.ts (mode=play), by the agent when authoring new shortcuts, and (p3.21+) as JOIN-VOLUME: any room newly added to a group via Group Speakers / geo Extend / play.ts is reset to its default before the topology change lands. Rooms not listed use volume_fallback.
